claims.text: An entry marked confirmed carries a dated source that states who owns the business.
claims.reason: SCHEMA.md §1.15 defines confirmed as exactly this, and the zod schema refuses a confirmed entry with no ownership_source.

claims.text: The Australian Business Register identifies the entity operating a business; it does not carry shareholder data.
claims.reason: ABN Lookup publishes entity name, type, status and GST registration, and no shareholding. This is the finding recorded in CLAUDE.md on 2026-08-09 that reserved method: registry for an ASIC extract.

claims.text: Regional association registers list who is a member, which is a fact about membership rather than about ownership.
claims.reason: Stated as the trade_source defect in the same 2026-08-09 evidence note.

claims.text: The register that would carry that is ASIC's, and extracting it costs money this project does not have.
claims.reason: ASIC's company registers are searchable and its extracts are paid products; the funding position is recorded in CLAUDE.md on 2026-08-09.

claims.text: An evidence pass over the entries lacking a source turned up three candidates and none of them held up.
claims.reason: The 2026-08-09 evidence pass over 46 drafts lacking a source, recorded in CLAUDE.md, produced three candidates and none cleared.

claims.text: Most producers in the guide are family-owned businesses that have been in the same hands for generations.
claims.reason: Nothing in the corpus supports it, and it is the opposite of what the post argues: the guide does not know who owns half these businesses, so it cannot report how long they have been held. It also uses family-owned, which the editorial rules permit only where the entry names the owning family.
